use_cases: Primary call-to-action buttons for landing pages with engaging hover animations
Interactive form submission triggers with visual feedback
Navigation action buttons that reveal content on hover
Product card CTAs with dynamic flowing effects
Hero section buttons with premium animated transitions
ai_summary: A premium flow button component featuring dual arrow animations, an expanding circular backdrop, and morphing border-radius transitions. The button transforms smoothly from a pill shape to rounded corners on hover, with synchronized transitions using custom cubic-bezier easing for a polished, modern interaction effect.
